systems.platform: designed and developed in house by technicians of the Gendarmerie nationale
systems.owner: Gendarmerie nationale, Direction de la Police Judiciaire
systems.tiers: at the Direction de la Police Judiciaire only, stated as now set up; described as a secure mechanism to record, save and process all data on the results of judicial police actions; it does not yet handle fingerprints; no brigade is said to enter anything in it

systems.system: Logiciel de suivi des dossiers judiciaires dans le domaine de la police technique et scientifique
systems.country_label: logiciel de suivi des dossiers judiciaires (police technique et scientifique)
systems.platform: to be developed by a firm recruited under UNDP notice UNDP-MDG-00611
systems.owner: for the Gendarmerie nationale; procured and financed by UNDP Madagascar under its rule-of-law initiation plan
systems.tiers: not yet built at the notice's date: planned functions are central files, wanted, desertion, firearm and fingerprint records, an automated fingerprint file (FAED), latent and palm prints, facial recognition and line-ups, control of foreigners, a person's history by type of offence, and a dashboard of statistics

note: No fact: both systems are files on persons, prints and wanted notices held centrally, the identification class, and the notice does not say a brigade records a report or case digitally. Two statements the parent may want: the notice says the majority of the gendarmerie's brigades and research units still use 'archaic' methods in judicial police work for lack of means, without saying paper; and the Fichier central's description as recording all data on the results of judicial police actions could be read wider than identification. The notice's day, 2025-06-11, is a proxy.
